entities.name: Carlos Ignacio Fernández Lobbe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos Ignacio Fernández Lobbe is an Argentine rugby union coach and former player. He last played with English side, Bath Rugby in the Aviva Premiership. He has also represented Argentina on numerous occasions, including at the 1999, 2003 and 2007 Rugby World Cups.
